'''February 2001 Buford tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Galactic Quest, Buford, GA on 3 February 2001. It is known from Adam Drake's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1706">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-06-galactic-quest-buford-ga-2-3-01d1706/ galactic-quest-buford-ga-2-3-01], DeckTech (Adam "ADrake" Drake, 6 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-06-galactic-quest-buford-ga-2-3-01d1706/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 3 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Galactic Quest, Buford, GA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 15
